notes.title: Master time-telling in multiple languages
notes.content:
Whether you're learning English, Spanish, French, German, or more, Time to Tell Time, turns every hour into an adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291308/957fbc9099303c2ab980f5ad5d14d648036cca47.gif[/img]

notes.title: Now you can learn to tell time in German!
notes.content:
You can now switch between English, Swedish, and German text and voice prompts, perfect for learning a new language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291308/4136faf01f4a36d8a241823260ec321d95563fdb.png[/img]

Please note that this is the first German version. If you find any errors in the translation, please get in touch with us, and we will fix them. More languages and updates are coming shortly. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Now with a Large Clock option
notes.content:
We have now added a large clock option in the game settings. When activated, a large representation of the currently selected clock is visible on the side of the display. Makes it easier to see and set the time.
You can resize the panel with the large clock and snap it to any side of the screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291308/c6b2c9af0ce2aa988f2dd2cd1119d46e28e02558.png[/img]

Tip! You can also use the plus (+) and minus (-) keys to set the clock that is currently selected.
